Problem Statement: Branch managers guess tomorrow's queue length from experience and staff accordingly, which leaves some branches overstaffed and others with long waits. A forecast from recent visit data would help managers plan rosters a day ahead and explain staffing choices to their regions.

Procurement shared mailboxes receive hundreds of supplier emails each week, and staff read every one to find invoices, disputes, and contract questions. Sorting the mailbox into those categories with a suggested owner would shorten response times and stop urgent disputes from waiting behind routine messages.
